briefTitle: Testing the Addition of High Dose, Targeted Radiation to the Usual Treatment for Locally-Advanced Inoperable Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0-2
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0-2

typedChecks.sourceText: Creatinine clearance >= 25 mL/min by the Cockcroft-Gault (C-G) equation
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Creatinine clearance >= 25 mL/min by the Cockcroft-Gault (C-G) equation

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with known PD-L1 status prior to registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requires known PD-L1 status without specifying a minimum or maximum percentage cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Up to 4 cycles of systemic therapy received prior to registration for the current study cancer is allowable; any prior chemotherapy for a different cancer is also permissible
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior systemic therapy limits up to 4 cycles do not map directly to a simple prior_lines_max check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Hematologic function (e.g. platelets, leukocytes, hemoglobin) amenable, at the discretion of the treating physician, to allow for treatment with chemotherapy and concurrent radiation therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Hematologic function is based on investigator discretion rather than fixed numeric cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects with non-malignant pleural effusion are eligible provided the effusion is not known or demonstrated to be an exudative effusion
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requires evaluation of pleural effusion exudative status which is a complex condition, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pathologically (histologically or cytologically) proven diagnosis of non-operable stage IIB or III, node positive (American Joint Committee on Cancer [AJCC] eighth edition) non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with known PD-L1 status prior to registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: evidence quote was not a verbatim substring of the trial text

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: with known PD-L1 status prior to registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Requires known status rather than a specific minimum or maximum numeric cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients must have an identified primary tumor and at least one nodal metastasis (peribronchial/hilar/intrapulmonary, mediastinal/subcarinal, supraclavicular/scalene)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Anatomical location rules for nodal metastases are complex and not expressible as simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Primary tumor =< 7 cm
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Primary tumor size cutoff is not a standard typed check kind in the schema.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Hematologic function (e.g. platelets, leukocytes, hemoglobin) amenable, at the discretion of the treating physician, to allow for treatment with chemotherapy and concurrent radiation therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Subjective investigator discretion on hematologic function rather than specific lab thresholds.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects with non-malignant pleural effusion are eligible provided the effusion is not known or demonstrated to be an exudative effusion
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pleural effusion characteristics and cytological exclusion rules are complex and subjective.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Medical history consistent with the patient being amenable, at the discretion of the treating physician, to allow for treating with consolidation immunotherapy.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator discretion regarding consolidation therapy suitability.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior radiotherapy to the study cancer (local recurrence). fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior radiotherapy exclusion depends on spatial overlap determined by the investigator.

fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Anatomical proximity and radiation field overlap judgment by the investigator.
